claim_scores.rationale: Creates `program = dspy.Predict(MySig)` once and reuses `program` for both calls without rebuilding or swapping signatures.
Edits the signature task wording between calls via `MySig.instructions = "Updated instruction."`.
Calls the predictor once before and once after the edit, so the second LM request reflects the updated class instructions.
Uses `lm.history[0]` and `lm.history[1]` system-message contents as the proof source rather than object inspection.
Prints both system messages and asserts the first has only the original instruction while the second has only the updated instruction.
